name: Admin payment account and instruction CRUD affect checkout
description: Verify payment settings CRUD through the exact admin route and confirm active records are published by the public checkout settings API.

planSteps.description: Navigate directly to /masuk. Fill Email with admin@rafstore.id, fill Password with Admin#Raf2026, and click the exact Masuk button.
Verify the URL becomes /admin and the text Raf Store Admin is visible.
Navigate directly to /admin/pengaturan-pembayaran. Do not search for an Admin link on the public homepage.
Verify the heading Pengaturan pembayaran, the Rekening bank tab, and the Instruksi transfer tab are visible.

Click Tambah rekening. Fill Nama bank=TestSprite Bank, Nomor rekening=5555516161, Nama pemilik rekening=TESTSPRITE RAF STORE, Urutan tampil=99, keep Aktif di checkout checked, and click Simpan rekening.
Verify the success message Rekening TestSprite Bank berhasil ditambahkan and the TestSprite Bank card with account 5555516161 are visible.

Click Instruksi transfer, click Tambah langkah, fill Judul langkah=TestSprite Payment Step, Teks instruksi=Gunakan referensi TS-PAYMENT-20260716 saat melakukan transfer, Urutan langkah=99, keep Tampilkan di checkout checked, and click Simpan instruksi.
Verify TestSprite Payment Step and TS-PAYMENT-20260716 are visible in Langkah transfer.
Navigate directly to /api/payment-settings in the same browser.
Verify the JSON page contains TestSprite Bank, 5555516161, TestSprite Payment Step, and TS-PAYMENT-20260716. This is the public endpoint consumed by checkout.

Return directly to /admin/pengaturan-pembayaran. Delete TestSprite Bank using Hapus rekening TestSprite Bank then confirm Hapus rekening. Open Instruksi transfer and delete TestSprite Payment Step using Hapus instruksi TestSprite Payment Step.
Verify both TestSprite records are absent and the original seed payment configuration remains visible.
